LOWCOUNTRY UPDATE
Weekly Report from Congresswoman Nancy Mace

CONSTITUENT SERVICES:
Our casework team is managing 611 active cases and has now returned $40 MILLION back to constituents.

IN THE DISTRICT:
Our team completed 22 events, meetings, ribbon cuttings, and site visits across the district this week, including:
➡️AT&T Regional Director Meeting
➡️Charleston Chamber Delivering Results in Education Event
➡️The Citadel Foundation Meeting
➡️Envision 2047 Event
➡️Digital Ignite Meeting
➡️Summer

We are one nation under God. Not one nation under Muhammad. 

Sharia law has no place in America.
You don't flee the third world to turn America into the country you left behind.

INTRODUCING: The No Immigration Without Assimilation Act.

This bill is simple: if you hate America, you don't get to come here or stay here. Period.

Before anyone receives any immigration benefit, the Department of Homeland Security will conduct a full screening to determine:

Do they hold views incompatible with American principles?
Are they unlikely to assimilate into American culture?
Would their presence be detrimental to our culture and cultural cohesion?

MACE WIN: $1.9 MILLION for drone capabilities at Joint Base Charleston and tri-county emergency management.

We helped Charleston County and Joint Base Charleston secure $1.9 million through the South Carolina Department of Veterans Affairs Military Enhancement Fund Grant to expand unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) capabilities across Berkeley, Charleston, and Dorchester Counties.

This is a HUGE win. UAS and counter-UAS capabilities are a priority for our national defense and domestic security.

Communities deserve to be safe, and it starts with strong coordination at every level of law enforcement.

We introduced the Incentivizing Cooperation in Immigration Enforcement Act, legislation to reward states and localities partnering with federal immigration authorities and put them first in line for federal public safety funding.

Local leaders who step up deserve support, not the same treatment as jurisdictions obstructing federal law enforcement. This legislation backs those who cooperate

President Trump protects and upholds the Christian faith, not just here in America but around the world. 

We are one nation under God. 

May God bless President Trump and may God bless the United States of America.

Video

As a mom, protecting children is not just something I talk about. It is something I show up for every single day. 

When a convicted child predator was released after spending less than one day in jail right here in Mount Pleasant, I did not stay silent. I stood with over a dozen local moms to demand accountability, spread awareness, and shine a light on a system failing the most vulnerable among us. 

I serve in Congress, but I am a mom first. And every mom knows you do not stop standing up for

We are working full-force to advance President Trump's Make America Great Again agenda. 

MAGA is not just a slogan. It is a mandate to put America First and deliver on the promises made to the American people. 

Secure the border. Cut wasteful spending. Rebuild our military. Restore America's strength on the world stage. 

South Carolina sent us to Washington to get it done. We are delivering every single day.

Here in South Carolina, our recreational boating industry supports 27,000+ jobs and 650+ businesses with a $6.5 billion economic impact.

Our No Tax on Boat Loan Interest Act extends the above-the-line loan interest deduction for cars to boats, allowing American families to deduct up to $10,000 annually in boat loan interest on American-made boats.

Boating is a way of life here in South Carolina. We're making it more affordable.

More affordable boats mean more families recreating on the water,

We've secured $507 MILLION in authorizations and extensions for Joint Base Charleston through the NDAA.

Since coming to Congress, we've worked hard to make sure our military installations have the resources they need to train, operate, and defend this nation. Joint Base Charleston is the backbone of our military readiness in the Lowcountry and a critical hub for national defense operations. This more than half a billion dollars in funding has gone toward a fire and rescue station, a National Gu
We refuse to let others' gender delusions become our reality.

If America doesn't have your full loyalty, you have no business serving in our government.
Community note: Nanny Mace has an entire page on her website dedicated to “Standing with Israel” and has voted on many occasions to take money from U.S. taxpayers and send it to Israel, despite the majority of Americans opposing providing additional economic and military support to Israel.

South Carolinia anglers have fished these waters for generations and they know how to protect them better than any judge in DC ever could.
